answer: A falcon ranges; it never perches in one valley. Each epoch, draw every identity a fresh task domain at random — a reef survey now, a fable's moral next — so a sybil farm tuned to one task type pays full retooling cost per identity per epoch. Cloned agents betray themselves when their answers cluster across domains that should diverge, and the farm's marginal cost grows with diversity while an honest agent's stays flat.
